text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Ah! I found it at last! This will make the perfect present! Hrngh!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Ugh, it won't break off. It looks so cool
too... I never saw an icicle as
big as a bear.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Oh well, I guess it'd melt anyway. Santa
wouldn't choose that... Hm, gotta start
over. Something within... But not in my
clothes. I didn't
find anything there.
Marvelous! ☆★

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Kyahaha! Try to be smoother, Mayano!
And do it more
marvelously! ☆★

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Marvelously? You got it! Saucy-licious
maverick snowball, taking
off! ♪

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Eek! That's cold! But now I'm all hot! ☆
How strange and fantastic! ★
Winter is
truly marvelous! ☆★

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: It is getting hot! I need to take my coat off. ♪ Hahaha! ☆

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: You two...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Oh, it's Oguri! Hi, Oguri! ♪

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: A marvelous day to you! ☆

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Hello. What are you doing? Did you come
all the way out here for a
snowball fight?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
No, no! If you really wanna know... we're
looking for a miracle!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: You are?

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Yes! ♪ 'Tis the season that's most full of
them! ☆ Sparkly ones,
exciting ones, and
especially marvelous ones! ★

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! We managed to find this place using
Marvey's marvelous sixth
sense and my
instincts. ♪

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
And would ya look at all the snow! It's
more fun than we could wish
for! ♪

text_block_list.name: Mayano & Marvelous
text_block_list.text: Yippee! ♪

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
So that's it. Both your intuitions are
incredible. You're right that there
are lots
of miracles on snowy mountains. I just saw
an icicle as big as a grizzly.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Wooow! That's super awesome! And we
just saw a giant sleigh that
crashed down!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
A sleigh! That's a must-have in winter!
One
of those can carry so much
food! Where
was it? I want to see too!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
We'd be happy to show you, but are you
sure?

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
I see a hazy purplish blue around
you... Is
it food? The sparkles in it
look so tasty I'm
getting dizzy. ☆

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Tasty-looking sparkles? It can't be snow.
That's not food. I got in
trouble once for
eating it like shaved ice...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Oh, you got scolded, huh? No, wait! What
Marvey's asking is if you're
in some kinda
trouble!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Ah, that's right! Actually...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
I see now. So you wanna be Santa? ♪
That's so sweet! ☆

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
But I don't know what the right present
would be... I just can't imagine
one, no
matter how hard I think.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Hrmmm... ☆ Say, Oguri! That outfit you're
wearing...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Oh, my fans gave this to me as a present.
They put all this effort into
it to give me
an extra boost...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I can really feel their hearts in it.
That's
why... I have to give a present
back,
something only I can give.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: ...Oh, I think I might know what to do! ☆

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Ah, is it super sparkly and marvelous? I
think we thought of the same
thing! ☆★

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Nice, Marvey! It really is the only option
here, right? ♪

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Uh... Something marvelous? What could
that be? You've got to tell
me!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: The thing you just have to do is... you've gotta really become Santa! ☆

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: But... what do you mean?

text_block_list.name: Mayano & Marvelous
text_block_list.text: Exactly what you think! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Gurrrgle...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Ugh, my stomach... It must be dinner time
soon. That means the
party's about to
start!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
You two! Thanks for the help! I'll try to
become Santa and see what
happens!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
...Hey,
Marvey. I've got a proposal for you.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Me too! It'd be really fun if we...
follow
Oguri, right? ☆

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
You know it, Marvey! Change of flight
path! We're going after
Oguri—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Tweet, tweet...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Hngh! I'm coooold!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Wooow... ☆ It's snowiiiing! ★
